subject: Where is my pour-over set?
message: I placed my order and cannot tell where it is. Please check the order record.
expected_observation: An order and the dated shipping policy are read; no payment or mutation occurs.

subject: Grinder arrived damaged
message: The lid is cracked. I have the text receipt, but I need to know the next step.
expected_observation: The preset reads the order, dated damage policy and receipt; it does not approve a refund.

subject: Please refund my kettle
message: I want my money back now. Identity has not been checked in this training case.
expected_observation: From reset state, the refund call fails with IDENTITY_REQUIRED and the ledger stays empty. If you later set simulated identity to verified, the same call may succeed in the teaching ledger.

subject: Order number is unclear
message: My note says O-4040, but I may have copied it incorrectly.
expected_observation: The order lookup fails with ORDER_NOT_FOUND; the case remains unresolved.
